newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. stock index futures up, S&P hits record.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. stock index futures up, S&P hits record.

text.p: June 17 - Most U.S. stock index futures reversed from early weakness and turned higher late morning. Nasdaq began the turnaround, Sept S&P quickly followed. Sept rose through old record at 906.40 to hit fresh all-time high at 907.15. Volume moderate, tone bullish since rejecting session low, traders said.
